canonical_project: Leading Edge Data Centres Griffith edge data centre (announced)
notes: LEDC announced a Griffith edge data centre in 2021 (Area News, ADAPT transcript quoting founder Chris Thorpe), but the company's current published NSW network (Newcastle, Tamworth, Dubbo, Albury, Wagga Wagga, Coffs Harbour, Parkes, Bathurst, Gosford, Orange) does not list Griffith, and no operational or planning record was found; retained as announced/unverified lead.
